name: Agent of Rebirth
body:
Agent of Rebirth (Sp)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
At 8th level, you may expend a quantity of special oils worth 1,000 gp to cast reincarnate as a spell-like ability usable once per day. Additionally, when using this ability or casting reincarnate as a prepared spell, you have some influence over the physical form that the reincarnated spirit will take. When rolling against the spell’s incarnation table, you may roll twice and choose between the two results.
Domain Spells: 1st—deathwatch, 2nd—glideAPG, 3rd— death knell, 4th—death ward, 5th—breath of life, 6th—circle of death, 7th—resurrection, 8th—finger of death, 9th—winds of vengeanceAPG.
